justification: Yes. In android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java the class acts as the central coordinator for scanning: it imports and uses multiple local components (CameraManager, HistoryActivity/HistoryItem/HistoryManager, ResultHandler/ResultHandlerFactory, ShareActivity, ClipboardInterface, SupplementalInfoRetriever, ResultButtonListener) and drives camera, decode, history, and result-handling workflows. Fan-in is also strong: AndroidManifest.xml declares CaptureActivity as the launcher/scan entry point, and 8 repo files reference it directly: CaptureActivityHandler.java, DecodeThread.java, DecodeHandler.java, ResultHandlerFactory.java, WifiResultHandler.java, HistoryActivity.java, BeepManager.java, and CameraManager.java. This bidirectional coupling is consistent with hub-like modularization.
